Class PrimitiveValueConverters

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.bind.PrimitiveValueConverters
@Internal public final class PrimitiveValueConverters extends Object
The converters of string values to primitives of a conversion service, for the primitive accessors of NamedValues: the parsers that the converters the conversion service resolves for Argument.INT and the other constants hold, which convert without the context of the value. When the conversion service converts with another converter, e.g. one a registrar replaced the parser with, there is none: the value converts with its context, which the converter may read and reject it in. The default conversion service shares the resolved converters, so asking for them costs nothing per value; another conversion service, a subclass of it included, is not asked: its values convert by boxing.
Since:
5.3.0

  • Field Details

    • MAX_PARSED_LENGTH

      public static final int MAX_PARSED_LENGTH
      The length of the longest value a parser is tried with: a longer one, e.g. a malformed one an attacker chose, converts like any value, so a value that does not parse is parsed once more only when it is short.
